question_stem:
Two small solid metal spheres A and B have equal radii and are in a vacuum. Their centres are
15 cm apart.
Sphere A has charge +3.0 pC and sphere B has charge +12 pC. The arrangement is illustrated in
Fig. 5.1.
Point P lies on the line joining the centres of the spheres and is a distance of 5.0 cm from the
centre of sphere A.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Suggest why the electric field strength in both spheres is zero.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Show that the electric field strength is zero at point P. Explain your working.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Calculate the electric potential at point P.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
A silver-107 nucleus (^{107}
_{47}Ag) has speed v when it is a long distance from point P.
Use your answer in (c) to calculate the minimum value of speed v such that the nucleus can
reach point P.
$speed = m s ^{1} $
